title: The Structure of Financial Equity Research Reports -- Identification of the Most Frequently Asked Questions in Financial Analyst Reports to Automate Equity Research Using Llama 3 and GPT-4

live_model.evidence: Sec IV-D: "the closed-source GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09 model... We set the temperatures of both models to zero..."; "GPT-4 is able to extract the correct answer in 26% of the questions (figure 5)."

prompt.location: Sec IV-D (annual-report text supplied as context, then the single question asked; temperature 0, no output-token cap)
prompt.note: No exact wording is quoted, but the template (report-as-context + question) is simple and fully specified.

claim.metric: extraction accuracy on text-extractable ERR questions

data.source: 72 company annual reports / equity research reports (individually public filings, not bundled as a released dataset); authors' own 169-question list

notes: Llama-3-70B scores 27% on the same 200 questions; an ensemble of both models reaches 84%, but that combined figure is not attributable to GPT-4-turbo alone. Annual reports run ~100k tokens, so per-call cost may exceed the 'short call' heuristic.
